# mermaid (vendored)

`mermaid.min.js` is mermaid 11.17.2, unmodified, from the npm registry
(`https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-11.17.2.tgz`, integrity
`sha512-V6K3C8EBdEsPFZXSKMJe6ppQOENxuHARr9GvHX4hh47lAbhMRD9qf4oEK7LoaRQxULMa80/qt5gHO73aCleBBg==`;
file sha256 `581ed7d74bd9048d0e3a91363927d72ef22942d7722546b27f7cc29e35390eb8`). MIT — see `LICENSE`.

`mangsang report --html` inlines it so the page draws its graph with no network and nothing installed.
It is pinned: a newer mermaid comes in with a mangsang version, never on its own.
